title: FutureX-Pro: Extending Future Prediction to High-Value Vertical Domains
reasoning: The paper discusses model "safety" in the context of avoiding misinformation and ensuring reliability in high-stakes domains (Public Health, Natural Disaster), and the trade-off between utility and caution. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component; the focus is on factual accuracy, risk management, and practical implications of model behavior.
